generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
General conditions as per bid document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one civil/similar nature of work of value not less than Rs 10.00 Lakhs (including GST) in the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The certificate issued by the competent Authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer and equivalent in case of other Government Organizations is to be uploaded in the technical bid. (Work done of Value of works of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited.).

The Intending bidder in his name should have achieved in atleast two financial years an average annual Financial Turnover of Rs 20.00 Lakhs (Including GST) during the preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit certified copy of the turnover certificate duly certified by the Chartered Accountant for the respective two years & the same shall be uploaded along with the technical bid. (Financial turnover of of Value of works of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited).
